title: gpt-loop job request
description: The complete immutable broker execution envelope. In the current GitHub transport this is the body of a [GPT-LOOP] issue and is read from the issues.opened event. Editing the issue afterwards cannot change what runs. Canonical project work lives in the consumer repository and is referenced by work_ref.

protocol_version.description: Unknown versions fail deterministically as invalid_request.

job_id.description: UUID chosen by the requester. Also names the stored full result.

project.description: A key in the machine-local project registry. NOT a path: the request can never choose a filesystem root.

work_ref.description: Non-authorizing pointer back to canonical work in the consumer repository. It never selects a workspace; project placement still comes only from trusted machine-local registry policy. Legacy packets may omit this during Phase-2 migration.

repository.description: Canonical owner/repository for the project work. Dot and dot-dot path-like segments are forbidden.

path.description: Optional repository-relative canonical checkpoint/plan path. Metadata only; it grants no file authority.

action.description: A core action or one declared by the project's profile. Unknown actions fail as invalid_request.

params.description: Action-specific arguments. Every field is optional unless the action requires it; absent optional fields must never crash the dispatcher.

parent_event_id.description: The wake event that prompted this job, for chain auditing.

note.description: Free-text human context. Ignored by the dispatcher.
